task.instruction: put the red block in the bowl

robot.name: panda
robot.note: the default; its action and observation spaces match LIBERO's

frame: world: metres, z up, the table top at z = 0.75; x away from the robot base, y to its left; quaternions x y z w

action.chunk: an answer is {actions: (T, 10)}: the hand's absolute pose (position and the first two columns of its rotation) and the gripper (0 open, 1 closed); the rows run in order, one per control step, then the next observation is sent

cameras.name: agentview
cameras.about: the scene's reference camera, square, with its horizontal field

cameras.name: wrist
cameras.about: on the hand, behind the fingers, looking along them

success: Nothing moves before the robot starts.
Both finger sides push on the target with at least 0.5 N for 0.2 s.
Held by the fingers alone, the target rises at least 20 mm.
The hand lets go and does not touch the target again.
The target ends within 20 mm of its destination, resting only on its support.
After release, the target stays upright and still for 2 s.
No other loose object moves more than 5 mm or turns more than 5 degrees.
No object jumps further than its velocity allows.
The target moves without contact only when it falls.
The routine runs to its end without an error.
